The '''Corellian Foray Flyer 56''', also known as '''CFF-56''', was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. It was carried in the cargo bay of the [[Tantive IV/Legends|Tantive IV]].

It was extensively modified for her use, with upgraded armor and numerous concealed weapons including a retractable [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. It had a sophisticated sensor system, reconnaissance and surveillance technology and a [[Ealewon Electronics]] [[DCD-4800 Cryptographic Coder]].
